parameters.description:
`msg-to-kumulos` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Kumulos destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Kumulos destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Kumulos destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Kumulos destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Kumulos notifications API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Kumulos destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's KUMULOS_BASIC value (same format as KUMULOS_BASIC)
